newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Austria's SEZ plans Swiss IPO in mid-November.
newsitem.headline: Austria's SEZ plans Swiss IPO in mid-November.

text.p: SEZ Holding AG, a newly-created holding company for Austria's SEZ Semiconductor-Equipment Zubehoer fuer die Halbleiterfertigung AG plans to list 47 percent of its capital in mid-November, a spokesman for the lead manager Bank J. Vontobel & Co AG said.
Subscription to the 113,890 registered shares with a par value of 50 Swiss francs will be from November 13 to 18.
SEZ will hold a news conference on November 12 in Zurich to announce the price of the shares.
SEZ's share capital comprises 192,000 registered shares with a par value of 50 francs and 250,000 registered shares with a par value of 10 francs.

In the first nine months of this year, the group net profit of SEZ rose 120 percent to 4.8 million francs, pre-tax operating profit rose 134 percent to 7.0 million francs and net sales were up 67 percent to 32.6 million.
For the current year, SEZ expects net profit of 6.9 million francs, an operating profit of 8.6 million and sales of 43.1 million.
The founders and current joint chief executives of SEZ, Egon Putzi and Franz Sumnitsch, are chairman and vice-chairman respectively of SEZ Holding, which was founded September 26.
The proceeds would be used to finance the group's expansion plans and to repay existing credits, the company has said.
SEZ, based in the southern Austrian resort town of Villach, makes machines used for the production of computer chips.
